title: Linearization in nonlocal elasticity via Gamma-convergence
summary: Linearization is a classical tool in continuum mechanics that connects nonlinear models of solids to their linear counterparts through the small-strain limit, as in the passage from finite to linear elasticity. Here, we study a nonlocal analogue of this limit process in the context of state-based peridynamics, starting from a class of models in nonlocal hyperelasticity subject to nonlocal Dirichlet boundary conditions.
